new_records_needed: Marty Jackley (R); Nikki Gronli (D) -- NOTE-SD-OPEN-SEAT: incumbent Dusty Johnson did NOT seek House re-election; he filed for Governor of South Dakota instead (confirmed via official SD SOS candidate lists, vip.sdsos.gov eid=773 and eid=774, both listing 'Governor Dusty Johnson REP' filed 03/16/2026 and showing NO Dusty Johnson entry under 'United States Representative'; also corroborated by Politico, https://www.politico.com/live-updates/2025/06/27/congress/dusty-johnson-run-south-dakota-governor-race-00430268). Johnson is not on the 2026 U.S. House ballot in any capacity. All 2 general candidates are new records -- none is the incumbent. Jackley won the R primary (79.2%) over James Bialota Jr. on June 2, 2026; Gronli ran unopposed for the D nomination. NOTE-SD-INDEPENDENT: declared independent Jack Pittman (FEC Form 2 filed per Wikipedia sourcing) does NOT appear on the SD SOS official 2026 General Election certified candidate list (https://vip.sdsos.gov/candidatelist.aspx?eid=774 -- the authoritative list of candidates, including independents, who filed qualifying nominating petitions), which lists only Jackley (R) and Gronli (D) under United States Representative. SD's independent nominating-petition deadline (April 28, 2026, per https://sdsos.gov/elections-voting/upcoming-elections/general-information/2026/2026-Independent-Candidate-Information.aspx) has already passed, so Pittman did not qualify and the U.S. House general field is final with only the two major-party nominees.
